about:
Madden Fabrication operates from Portland, Oregon, where it was founded in 1992 as a division of a parent company. The business has remained in the same location for over three decades, serving the Pacific Northwest from a single facility.

The shop occupies 18,000 square feet and runs CNC plasma cutting, 120-ton and 50-ton ironworkers, a programmable draw bender, and a full suite of welding processes including GMAW, FCAW, GTAW, SMAW, and SAW. Design work is handled in-house with AutoCAD and SolidWorks. The company works with carbon steel, structural steel, stainless steel, aluminum, nickel alloys, and exotic metals, producing structural, architectural, and ornamental metal fabrications. It also provides field installation and repair within a roughly 100-mile radius of Portland.

Madden Fabrication serves industrial, commercial, and residential construction markets. Industrial clients include municipalities, geothermal projects, mills, and chemical plants, where the shop supplies valve and pipe assemblies, precision parts, and safety upgrades. Commercial work covers restaurants, retail spaces, new construction, and remodels, delivering handrails, guardrails, canopies, awnings, and building envelope components. Residential projects range from custom stair railings and balcony guards to gates and ornamental pieces for homeowners and designers. The portfolio also includes bridge components, parking garage structures, and multi-family housing.

The company emphasizes its 30-plus years of experience, adherence to relevant codes and standards, and a quality program developed under American Society of Mechanical Engineers guidelines. Its stated mission is "precision, innovation, excellence," aiming to build lasting client relationships through superior service and dedication to craft.
